schema.title: Samplesheet
schema.description: One row per pair of FASTQ files. Rows with the same sample name, such as one per sequencing lane, are merged by the pipeline. Alevin-fry, kallisto | bustools, STARsolo and Cell Ranger need only the sample and its two FASTQs. Cell Ranger ARC: give the GEX and ATAC rows of a sample the same sample name, set Sample Type on every row, and add each ATAC row's third read (R3) under ATAC R3 FASTQ. Cell Ranger multi: give every library of a sample the same sample name, and set Feature Type on every row.

sample.title: Sample
sample.errorMessage: Sample name must be provided and cannot contain spaces

fastq_1.title: FASTQ (R1)
fastq_1.errorMessage: Must be a gzipped read FASTQ (.fastq.gz or .fq.gz) with no spaces in its name, not an I1/I2 index read

fastq_2.title: FASTQ (R2)
fastq_2.errorMessage: Must be a gzipped read FASTQ (.fastq.gz or .fq.gz) with no spaces in its name, not an I1/I2 index read

fastq_barcode.title: ATAC R3 FASTQ
fastq_barcode.description: Cell Ranger ARC ATAC rows only: the library's third read. Cell Ranger ARC tells the three reads apart by file name. Leave blank on other rows
fastq_barcode.errorMessage: Must be a gzipped FASTQ (.fastq.gz or .fq.gz) with no spaces in its name

expected_cells.title: Expected Cells
expected_cells.description: Optional, for Alevin-fry, STARsolo and Cell Ranger. Give every row of a sample the sample's total

seq_center.title: Sequencing Center
seq_center.description: Optional, for STARsolo's BAM files. Overrides the form's Sequencing Center; give every row of a sample the same value

sample_type.title: Sample Type
sample_type.description: Cell Ranger ARC only: gex for gene expression rows, atac for chromatin accessibility rows

feature_type.title: Feature Type
feature_type.description: Cell Ranger multi only: gex (gene expression), vdj (V(D)J), ab (antibody capture), crispr (CRISPR guide capture) or cmo (cell multiplexing oligos)
